properties.natural_language: PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-TX-SUBMITTER (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-TX-SUBMITTED into STATE-CREATE-TX-RECEIVED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Full transaction validation required including initcode size check (max 49152 bytes), signature verification, and gas validation.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-TX-INITCODE] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-TX-SUBMITTED from UNTRUSTED entity EXT-TX-SUBMITTER SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-CREATE-TX-RECEIVED.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-TX-SUBMITTED SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-TX-SUBMITTER to internal state STATE-CREATE-TX-RECEIVED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Extract Initcode' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Creation Transaction Received'. Contract creation transaction (to=null) received for validation
POSTCOND: After action 'Extract Initcode' completes successfully, action 'Check Initcode Size' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Compare against limit
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Initcode Size' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Initcode Size Exceeded'. Initcode length > 49152 bytes - transaction invalid
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Initcode Size' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Initcode Size Valid'. Initcode length <= 49152 bytes - proceed with validation
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Initcode Size Exceeded', it SHALL transition to state 'Transaction Rejected'. Transaction is invalid
PRECOND: Action 'Continue Transaction Validation' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Initcode Size Valid'. Initcode length <= 49152 bytes - proceed with validation
PRECOND: Action 'Calculate Initcode Words' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Initcode Ready for Gas Calculation'. Initcode passed size validation, ready for gas metering
POSTCOND: After action 'Calculate Initcode Words' completes successfully, action 'Compute Initcode Cost' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: words * 2 gas
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Initcode Cost' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Initcode Cost Calculated'. Total initcode gas cost determined
PRECOND: Action 'Add to Intrinsic Gas' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Initcode Cost Calculated'. Total initcode gas cost determined
POSTCOND: After action 'Add to Intrinsic Gas' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Intrinsic Gas Updated'. Transaction intrinsic gas includes initcode cost
PRECOND: Action 'Check Gas Limit Sufficient' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Intrinsic Gas Updated'. Transaction intrinsic gas includes initcode cost
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Gas Limit Sufficient' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Insufficient Gas'. Gas limit too low for intrinsic + initcode cost
PRECOND: Action 'Read Initcode from Memory' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'CREATE/CREATE2 Executing'. EVM is executing CREATE or CREATE2 opcode
POSTCOND: After action 'Read Initcode from Memory' completes successfully, action 'Check Initcode Size' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Validate size
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Initcode Size' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Size Limit Exceeded'. Initcode exceeds 49152 bytes - exceptional abort
PRECOND: Action 'Exceptional Abort' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Size Limit Exceeded'. Initcode exceeds 49152 bytes - exceptional abort
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Initcode Size' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Size Valid'. Initcode within limits - proceed with creation
PRECOND: Action 'Charge Initcode Gas' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Size Valid'. Initcode within limits - proceed with creation
POSTCOND: After action 'Charge Initcode Gas' completes successfully, action 'Compute Contract Address' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Compute new address
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Contract Address' completes successfully, action 'Execute Initcode' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Run initcode

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-ATTACKER (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-SUBMIT-LARGE into STATE-INITCODE-SUBMITTED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: EIP-3860 size limits mitigate DoS via jumpdest analysis. Attacker must pay ~80M additional gas for attack, making it economically infeasible.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-MALICIOUS-INITCODE] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-SUBMIT-LARGE from UNTRUSTED entity EXT-ATTACKER SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-INITCODE-SUBMITTED.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-SUBMIT-LARGE SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-ATTACKER to internal state STATE-INITCODE-SUBMITTED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Perform Jumpdest Analysis' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Large Initcode Submitted'. Contract creation with large initcode received
POSTCOND: After action 'Perform Jumpdest Analysis' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Analysis Cost Pre-EIP-3860'. Before limits: ~1.3GB initcode possible, analysis very expensive
POSTCOND: After action 'Perform Jumpdest Analysis' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Analysis Cost Post-EIP-3860'. After limits: max 49KB initcode, analysis bounded
PRECOND: Action 'Charge Analysis Cost' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Analysis Cost Post-EIP-3860'. After limits: max 49KB initcode, analysis bounded
POSTCOND: After action 'Charge Analysis Cost' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'DoS Vector Mitigated'. Attack requiring ~80M additional gas, substantially more expensive
PRECOND: Action 'Pop Operands from Stack' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Bitwise Opcode Fetched'. EVM has fetched a bitwise opcode (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, BYTE, SHL, SHR, SAR)
POSTCOND: After action 'Pop Operands from Stack' completes successfully, action 'Charge GAS_VERY_LOW' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Operands available
POSTCOND: After action 'Pop Operands from Stack' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Stack Underflow Error'. Insufficient stack items for operation
POSTCOND: After action 'Charge GAS_VERY_LOW' completes successfully, action 'Execute Bitwise Operation' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Gas charged
POSTCOND: After action 'Execute Bitwise Operation' completes successfully, action 'Push Result to Stack' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Computation done
POSTCOND: After action 'Push Result to Stack' completes successfully, action 'Increment Program Counter' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Result on stack
POSTCOND: After action 'Increment Program Counter' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Bitwise Operation Complete'. Operation finished, ready for next instruction
PRECOND: Action 'Compute Bitwise AND' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'AND Operands Ready'. Two U256 values popped for AND operation
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Bitwise AND' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Logical Result Ready'. Bitwise logical operation result computed
PRECOND: Action 'Compute Bitwise OR' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'OR Operands Ready'. Two U256 values popped for OR operation
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Bitwise OR' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Logical Result Ready'. Bitwise logical operation result computed
PRECOND: Action 'Compute Bitwise XOR' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'XOR Operands Ready'. Two U256 values popped for XOR operation
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Bitwise XOR' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Logical Result Ready'. Bitwise logical operation result computed
PRECOND: Action 'Compute Bitwise NOT' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'NOT Operand Ready'. Single U256 value popped for NOT operation
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Bitwise NOT' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Logical Result Ready'. Bitwise logical operation result computed
PRECOND: Action 'Check SHL Overflow' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'SHL Operands Ready'. Shift amount and value popped for left shift
POSTCOND: After action 'Check SHL Overflow' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Shift Result is Zero'. Large shift resulted in zero (SHL/SHR) or MAX for negative SAR
POSTCOND: After action 'Check SHL Overflow' completes successfully, action 'Compute Left Shift' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: shift < 256
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Left Shift' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Shift Result Computed'. Normal shift operation completed
PRECOND: Action 'Check SHR Overflow' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'SHR Operands Ready'. Shift amount and value popped for logical right shift
POSTCOND: After action 'Check SHR Overflow' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Shift Result is Zero'. Large shift resulted in zero (SHL/SHR) or MAX for negative SAR
POSTCOND: After action 'Check SHR Overflow' completes successfully, action 'Compute Logical Right Shift' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: shift < 256
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Logical Right Shift' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Shift Result Computed'. Normal shift operation completed
PRECOND: Action 'Convert to Signed Integer' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'SAR Operands Ready'. Shift amount and value popped for arithmetic right shift
POSTCOND: After action 'Convert to Signed Integer' completes successfully, action 'Compute Arithmetic Right Shift' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Perform arithmetic shift
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Arithmetic Right Shift' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Shift Result Computed'. Normal shift operation completed
PRECOND: Action 'Check Byte Index Bounds' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'BYTE Operands Ready'. Byte index and value popped from stack
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Byte Index Bounds' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'BYTE Result is Zero'. Index >= 32, return zero
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Byte Index Bounds' completes successfully, action 'Extract Target Byte' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: index < 32
POSTCOND: After action 'Extract Target Byte' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Byte Extracted'. Single byte extracted and zero-extended to U256

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-RPC-CLIENT (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-CLIENT-DISCOVERY-REQUEST into STATE-DISCOVER-REQUEST-RECEIVED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: rpc.discover method should only return method specifications. No sensitive data exposed. Rate limiting may be needed to prevent resource exhaustion.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-RPC-DISCOVER-REQUEST] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-CLIENT-DISCOVERY-REQUEST from UNTRUSTED entity EXT-RPC-CLIENT SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-DISCOVER-REQUEST-RECEIVED.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-CLIENT-DISCOVERY-REQUEST SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-RPC-CLIENT to internal state STATE-DISCOVER-REQUEST-RECEIVED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'RPC Service Ready', it SHALL transition to state 'Discovery Request Received'. Service ready to handle request
PRECOND: Action 'Generate OpenRPC Document' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Discovery Request Received'. System has received an rpc.discover method call
POSTCOND: After action 'Generate OpenRPC Document' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'OpenRPC Document Returned'. OpenRPC document has been successfully returned to caller
PRECOND: Action 'Parse Method Specification' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'OpenRPC Document Available'. Client has retrieved OpenRPC document from service
POSTCOND: After action 'Parse Method Specification' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Method Specification Known'. Client knows the expected parameters and return type for a method
PRECOND: Action 'Validate RPC Call' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Method Specification Known'. Client knows the expected parameters and return type for a method
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate RPC Call' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'RPC Call Validated'. RPC call parameters match the expected specification
POSTCOND: Edge EDGE-DOC-RETRIEVED from EXT-RPC-SERVICE to STATE-OPENRPC-DOC-AVAILABLE SHALL be valid: OpenRPC document retrieved from service

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-RPC-CALLER (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-REQUEST into STATE-RPC-REQUEST-RECEIVED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Method namespace checking required. Reserved 'rpc.' prefix methods should be handled specially. Input validation on all parameters.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-RECEIVE-REQUEST SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-RPC-CALLER to internal state STATE-RPC-REQUEST-RECEIVED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Check Method Namespace' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'RPC Request Received'. System has received an RPC method call
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Method Namespace' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'System Method Identified'. Method identified as reserved system extension method
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Method Namespace' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'User Method Identified'. Method identified as standard user-defined method

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-USER (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-USER-NAVIGATES into STATE-PAGE-LOAD-START SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Secure context check (isSecureContext) and trustworthy origin verification required before provider injection. HTTP non-localhost must be blocked.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-URL, DATA-ORIGIN] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-USER-NAVIGATES from UNTRUSTED entity EXT-USER SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-PAGE-LOAD-START.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-USER-NAVIGATES SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-USER to internal state STATE-PAGE-LOAD-START MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Check Secure Context Status' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Web Page Load Initiated'. Browser begins loading a web page that may request Ethereum provider
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Secure Context Status' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Context is Secure'. Page is loaded over HTTPS or is HTTP localhost
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Secure Context Status' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Context is Insecure'. Page is loaded over HTTP (non-localhost) or other insecure origin
PRECOND: Action 'Check Potentially Trustworthy Origin' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Context is Secure'. Page is loaded over HTTPS or is HTTP localhost
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Potentially Trustworthy Origin' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Origin is Trustworthy'. Origin passes all trustworthiness checks
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Potentially Trustworthy Origin' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Origin is Untrustworthy'. Origin fails trustworthiness verification
PRECOND: Action 'Inject window.ethereum Provider' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Origin is Trustworthy'. Origin passes all trustworthiness checks
POSTCOND: After action 'Inject window.ethereum Provider' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Provider Available'. window.ethereum is defined and accessible to the page
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Context is Insecure', it SHALL transition to state 'Provider Blocked'. Block provider - insecure context
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Origin is Untrustworthy', it SHALL transition to state 'Provider Blocked'. Block provider - untrustworthy origin
PRECOND: Action 'Check First vs Third Party' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Iframe Context Detected'. Code is executing within an iframe, not top-level window
POSTCOND: After action 'Check First vs Third Party' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'First-Party Iframe'. Iframe origin matches parent page origin (same-origin)
POSTCOND: After action 'Check First vs Third Party' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Third-Party Iframe'. Iframe origin differs from parent page origin (cross-origin)
PRECOND: Action 'Check Sandbox Attribute' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'First-Party Iframe'. Iframe origin matches parent page origin (same-origin)
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Sandbox Attribute' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Sandbox Configuration Compatible'. No sandbox attribute or sandbox='allow-same-origin' present
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Sandbox Attribute' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Sandbox Too Restrictive'. Sandbox attribute blocks provider access
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Sandbox Configuration Compatible', it SHALL transition to state 'Iframe Provider Access Allowed'. First-party iframe approved
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Sandbox Too Restrictive', it SHALL transition to state 'Iframe Provider Access Blocked'. Sandbox blocks access
PRECOND: Action 'Check Permissions API' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Third-Party Iframe'. Iframe origin differs from parent page origin (cross-origin)
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Permissions API' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Third-Party Permission Granted'. Explicit permission granted via Permissions API
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Permissions API' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Third-Party Permission Denied'. No permission for third-party provider access
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Third-Party Permission Granted', it SHALL transition to state 'Iframe Provider Access Allowed'. Third-party approved via permission
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Third-Party Permission Denied', it SHALL transition to state 'Iframe Provider Access Blocked'. Third-party blocked by default
PRECOND: Action 'Check Developer Mode Setting' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'HTTP Localhost Detected'. Page is served from http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Developer Mode Setting' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Developer Mode Enabled'. User has explicitly enabled developer mode in wallet settings
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Developer Mode Setting' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Developer Mode Disabled'. Developer mode is disabled (default state)
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Developer Mode Enabled', it SHALL transition to state 'Localhost Provider Allowed'. Allow HTTP localhost
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Developer Mode Disabled', it SHALL transition to state 'Localhost Provider Blocked'. Block HTTP localhost
PRECOND: Action 'Left Pad Zero Bytes' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Byte Value Received'. System state when a byte value requiring padding has been received for processing
PRECOND: Action 'Right Pad Zero Bytes' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Byte Value Received'. System state when a byte value requiring padding has been received for processing
POSTCOND: After action 'Left Pad Zero Bytes' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Byte Value Padded'. Byte value has been padded to the specified size and is ready for further processing
POSTCOND: After action 'Right Pad Zero Bytes' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Byte Value Padded'. Byte value has been padded to the specified size and is ready for further processing
PRECOND: Action 'Convert Size to Integer' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Size Parameter Received'. System state when size parameter (int, FixedUnsigned, or Uint) has been received
POSTCOND: After action 'Convert Size to Integer' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Size Converted'. Size parameter has been converted to integer and is ready for padding
PRECOND: Action 'Check Value Length' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Size Converted'. Size parameter has been converted to integer and is ready for padding
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Value Length' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Value Unchanged'. When value length >= size, the original value is returned unmodified
PRECOND: Action 'Execute Padding Operation' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Untrusted Size Input'. Size parameter received from potentially untrusted source without bounds validation

POSTCOND: After action 'Execute Padding Operation' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Memory Allocated for Result'. Memory has been allocated based on size parameter for the padded result

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-VALIDATOR-OPERATOR (trust=SEMI_TRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-OPERATOR-PROVIDES-FILE into STATE-IMPORT-FILE-RECEIVED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Validator must be completely stopped during import. File must pass JSON schema validation, genesis root check, and BLS pubkey validation. Missing signing roots treated as conflicts.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-INTERCHANGE-JSON] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-OPERATOR-PROVIDES-FILE from SEMI_TRUSTED entity EXT-VALIDATOR-OPERATOR SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-IMPORT-FILE-RECEIVED.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-OPERATOR-PROVIDES-FILE SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-VALIDATOR-OPERATOR to internal state STATE-IMPORT-FILE-RECEIVED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Validator Client Stopped', it SHALL transition to state 'Import File Received'. Confirm validator is stopped before import
PRECOND: Action 'Parse Interchange Format' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Import File Received'. JSON interchange file has been provided for import
POSTCOND: After action 'Parse Interchange Format' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Interchange Data Parsed'. JSON data has been successfully parsed into internal structures
PRECOND: Action 'Validate Genesis Validators Root' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Interchange Data Parsed'. JSON data has been successfully parsed into internal structures
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate Genesis Validators Root' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Genesis Root Validated'. The genesis validators root matches, confirming same network
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate Genesis Validators Root' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Genesis Root Mismatch'. The genesis validators root does not match current network
PRECOND: Action 'Merge Validator Records' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Genesis Root Validated'. The genesis validators root matches, confirming same network

POSTCOND: After action 'Merge Validator Records' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Slashing Protection DB Updated'. Local slashing protection database has been updated with imported records
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Genesis Root Mismatch', it SHALL transition to state 'Import Rejected'. Reject import due to network mismatch

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-BEACON-NODE (trust=SEMI_TRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-BEACON-NODE-REQUEST into STATE-BLOCK-SIGN-REQUEST SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Even from authenticated beacon node, must check block slot against slashing database. Never sign block at slot below minimum. Never sign conflicting block at same slot.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-BLOCK-PROPOSAL, DATA-SIGNING-ROOT] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-BEACON-NODE-REQUEST from SEMI_TRUSTED entity EXT-BEACON-NODE SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-BLOCK-SIGN-REQUEST.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-BEACON-NODE-REQUEST SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-BEACON-NODE to internal state STATE-BLOCK-SIGN-REQUEST MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Check Block Slashing Rules' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Block Signing Request Received'. A request to sign a block proposal has been received
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Block Slashing Rules' completes successfully, action 'Check Block Slot Floor' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: No conflicting block found
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Block Slashing Rules' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Block Conflict Detected'. Signing this block would create a slashable offense
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Block Slot Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Block Slot Valid'. Block slot is at or above the minimum allowed slot
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Block Slot Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Block Slot Below Floor'. Block slot is below minimum previously signed slot, signing rejected
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Block Slot Valid', it SHALL transition to state 'Block Signing Approved'. All checks passed
PRECOND: Action 'Sign Block Proposal' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Block Signing Approved'. Block has passed all slashing protection checks
POSTCOND: After action 'Sign Block Proposal' completes successfully, action 'Update Signed Blocks Database' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Record signed block
POSTCOND: After action 'Update Signed Blocks Database' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Block Signed Successfully'. Block has been signed and recorded in slashing protection

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-BEACON-NODE (trust=SEMI_TRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-BEACON-ATTESTATION-REQUEST into STATE-ATTESTATION-SIGN-REQUEST SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Must check for surround voting. Source and target epochs must be at or above minimum previously signed. Never sign attestation that would be slashable.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-ATTESTATION-DATA, DATA-SOURCE-EPOCH, DATA-TARGET-EPOCH] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-BEACON-ATTESTATION-REQUEST from SEMI_TRUSTED entity EXT-BEACON-NODE SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-ATTESTATION-SIGN-REQUEST.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-BEACON-ATTESTATION-REQUEST SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-BEACON-NODE to internal state STATE-ATTESTATION-SIGN-REQUEST MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Check Attestation Slashing Rules' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Attestation Signing Request Received'. A request to sign an attestation has been received
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Attestation Slashing Rules' completes successfully, action 'Check Source Epoch Floor' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: No surround vote detected

POSTCOND: After action 'Check Attestation Slashing Rules' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Attestation Conflict Detected'. Signing this attestation would create a slashable offense (surround vote)
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Source Epoch Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Source Epoch Valid'. Source epoch is at or above minimum allowed
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Source Epoch Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Epoch Below Floor'. Source or target epoch is below minimum, signing rejected
PRECOND: Action 'Check Target Epoch Floor' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Source Epoch Valid'. Source epoch is at or above minimum allowed
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Target Epoch Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Target Epoch Valid'. Target epoch is at or above minimum allowed
POSTCOND: After action 'Check Target Epoch Floor' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Epoch Below Floor'. Source or target epoch is below minimum, signing rejected
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Target Epoch Valid', it SHALL transition to state 'Attestation Signing Approved'. All attestation checks passed
PRECOND: Action 'Sign Attestation' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Attestation Signing Approved'. Attestation has passed all slashing protection checks
POSTCOND: After action 'Sign Attestation' completes successfully, action 'Update Signed Attestations Database' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Record signed attestation
POSTCOND: After action 'Update Signed Attestations Database' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Attestation Signed Successfully'. Attestation has been signed and recorded

PRECOND: Before processing data from EXT-EXTERNAL-CLIENT (trust=UNTRUSTED), all input crossing boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-UNTRUSTED into STATE-EXTERNAL-FILE-UNTRUSTED SHALL be validated. Security assumption: Full validation pipeline required: JSON schema, BLS pubkey format, signing root format. Conservative handling of missing signing roots. Could be maliciously crafted.

PRECOND: Data items [DATA-RAW-INTERCHANGE-FILE] flowing across boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-UNTRUSTED from UNTRUSTED entity EXT-EXTERNAL-CLIENT SHALL be integrity-checked and sanitized before any state transition from STATE-EXTERNAL-FILE-UNTRUSTED.

INV: The trust boundary at edge EDGE-RECEIVE-UNTRUSTED SHALL never be bypassed. All transitions from external entity EXT-EXTERNAL-CLIENT to internal state STATE-EXTERNAL-FILE-UNTRUSTED MUST traverse the validation path. No alternative path may circumvent this boundary.
PRECOND: Action 'Validate JSON Schema' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'External Interchange File Untrusted'. Interchange file received from external source has not been validated
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate JSON Schema' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'File Schema Validated'. The interchange file structure is valid
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate JSON Schema' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'File Schema Invalid'. The interchange file does not conform to required schema
PRECOND: Action 'Validate BLS Public Keys' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'File Schema Validated'. The interchange file structure is valid
POSTCOND: After action 'Validate BLS Public Keys' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Public Keys Validated'. All BLS public keys in the file are valid
PRECOND: Action 'Verify Signing Roots Format' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Public Keys Validated'. All BLS public keys in the file are valid
POSTCOND: After action 'Verify Signing Roots Format' completes successfully, action 'Handle Missing Signing Root' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Some signing roots missing
POSTCOND: After action 'Handle Missing Signing Root' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Conservative Protection Applied'. Missing signing roots treated as conflicts for maximum safety
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Conservative Protection Applied', it SHALL transition to state 'Interchange Data Trusted'. Data ready for import with conservative rules
PRECOND: Action 'Capture Pre-Execution State' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Opcode Pending Execution'. EVM has fetched next opcode and is ready to execute
POSTCOND: After action 'Capture Pre-Execution State' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Pre-Execution State Captured'. Snapshot of EVM state before opcode has been recorded
PRECOND: Action 'Execute Opcode' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Pre-Execution State Captured'. Snapshot of EVM state before opcode has been recorded
POSTCOND: After action 'Execute Opcode' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Opcode Executed'. Opcode execution complete, post-state available
PRECOND: Action 'Compute Gas Cost' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Opcode Executed'. Opcode execution complete, post-state available
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute Gas Cost' completes successfully, action 'Capture Return Data' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Capture return data if any
POSTCOND: After action 'Capture Return Data' completes successfully, action 'Build Trace JSON Object' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Assemble all trace fields
POSTCOND: After action 'Build Trace JSON Object' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Trace Object Ready'. JSON trace object fully constructed for output
PRECOND: Action 'Output Trace Line' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Trace Object Ready'. JSON trace object fully constructed for output
PRECOND: Action 'Compute State Root' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Transaction Execution Complete'. All opcodes in the transaction have been executed
POSTCOND: After action 'Compute State Root' completes successfully, action 'Collect Output Data' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Gather return data
POSTCOND: After action 'Collect Output Data' completes successfully, action 'Calculate Total Gas Used' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Sum gas consumption
POSTCOND: After action 'Calculate Total Gas Used' completes successfully, action 'Determine Pass/Fail Status' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Evaluate success
POSTCOND: After action 'Determine Pass/Fail Status' completes successfully, action 'Build Summary JSON Object' SHALL be the next operation. Transition: Assemble summary fields
POSTCOND: After action 'Build Summary JSON Object' completes, the system SHALL transition to state 'Summary Object Ready'. Summary JSON fully constructed
PRECOND: Action 'Output Summary Line' SHALL only be invoked when system is in state 'Summary Object Ready'. Summary JSON fully constructed
POSTCOND: When system is in state 'Opcode Executing', it SHALL transition to state 'Error Occurred During Execution'. Exception or revert triggered

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP3860-01]: The specification ambiguity 'The EIP states size check is done 'before' lighter checks but doesn't enumerate all checks and their order' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume size check occurs after basic transaction format validation but before call depth and balance checks.. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP3860-02]: The specification ambiguity 'The term 'exceptional abort' for CREATE/CREATE2 is not precisely defined' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume exceptional abort behaves like out-of-gas: all remaining gas consumed, execution reverts, CREATE returns 0.. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP3860-03]: The specification ambiguity 'The EIP does not specify whether the limit applies to EOF container deployments differently' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume MAX_INITCODE_SIZE applies uniformly to all initcode regardless of format (legacy or EOF).. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP3860-01]: The system assumes: All clients perform jumpdest analysis with similar computational cost per byte. If this assumption is violated: Clients with more expensive analysis could still be DoS vulnerable even with size limits. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP3860-02]: The system assumes: Attackers cannot find ways to trigger expensive computation with initcode under the size limit. If this assumption is violated: DoS vectors could still exist via algorithmic complexity attacks on smaller initcode. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP3860-03]: The system assumes: 49152 bytes (2 * MAX_CODE_SIZE) is sufficient for legitimate contract deployments. If this assumption is violated: Legitimate use cases requiring larger initcode would be blocked. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP3860-04]: The system assumes: Gas metering at 2 gas per 32-byte word adequately covers the computational cost of processing initcode. If this assumption is violated: Underpriced initcode processing could still allow resource exhaustion attacks. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-PRAGUE-BITWISE-01]: The specification ambiguity 'BYTE opcode indexes bytes 'left-to-right (most to least significant)' which is opposite to typical little-endian conventions' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume big-endian byte ordering: index 0 is the most significant byte (leftmost in 256-bit word). All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-PRAGUE-BITWISE-02]: The specification ambiguity 'SAR behavior for shift >= 256 with negative values states 'returns MAX_VALUE' but doesn't specify if this is signed or unsigned MAX' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume returns U256.MAX_VALUE (all 1s) as the sign-extended result of shifting a negative number. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-BITWISE-01]: The system assumes: All bitwise operations operate on 256-bit unsigned integers (U256). If this assumption is violated: Different integer widths could cause truncation or overflow in unexpected ways. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-BITWISE-02]: The system assumes: GAS_VERY_LOW constant is 3 gas for all bitwise operations. If this assumption is violated: Different gas costs could affect contract economic assumptions. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-BITWISE-03]: The system assumes: Stack underflow is detected before gas is charged. If this assumption is violated: Gas could be incorrectly deducted for operations that fail due to stack underflow. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-BITWISE-04]: The system assumes: Attacker cannot exploit timing differences between different shift amounts. If this assumption is violated: Timing side channels could leak information about operand values. Implementations SHOULD validate this assumption where possible.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP1901-01]: The specification ambiguity 'The specification does not define error handling if rpc.discover is called but the service cannot generate the OpenRPC document.' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume standard JSON-RPC error response should be returned with appropriate error code if document generation fails.. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP1901-02]: The specification ambiguity 'It is unclear whether the OpenRPC document should reflect runtime-available methods or all theoretically supported methods.' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume the document should reflect currently available methods based on node configuration and capabilities.. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

INV [Ambiguity AMB-EIP1901-03]: The specification ambiguity 'The specification mentions 'different method signatures across clients' but does not specify how to handle method signature conflicts.' SHALL be resolved as follows: Assume each client returns its own method signatures; consumers must handle client-specific differences.. All implementations MUST follow this interpretation consistently.

PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP1901-01]: The system assumes: The OpenRPC document returned by rpc.discover is assumed to be accurate and not tampered with.. If this assumption is violated: A malicious node could return incorrect method specifications, leading to client-side validation bypasses or unexpected behavior.. PRECOND [Assumption ASSUM-EIP1901-02]: The system assumes: The JSON-RPC connection is assumed to be secure (e.g., over HTTPS or local IPC)..
